from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np
import scipy.stats as stats

# Prepare the data for regression with share_immi_imputed as the response variable
X_share = df_merged[['iv_offshoring_1']].values.reshape(-1, 1)  # Predictor
y_share = df_merged['share_immi_imputed'].values  # Response

# Create a linear regression model for share_immi_imputed
model_share = LinearRegression()
model_share.fit(X_share, y_share)

# Get the coefficient and standard error for share_immi_imputed
coefficient_share = model_share.coef_[0]
std_error_share = np.std(model_share.predict(X_share) - y_share, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(y_share))

# Calculate the t-statistic and p-value for share_immi_imputed
t_stat_share = coefficient_share / std_error_share
p_value_share = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(abs(t_stat_share), len(y_share) - 1))

# Prepare the data for regression with empl_immi_imputed as the response variable
X_empl = df_merged[['iv_offshoring_1']].values.reshape(-1, 1)  # Predictor
y_empl = df_merged['empl_immi_imputed'].values  # Response

# Create a linear regression model for empl_immi_imputed
model_empl = LinearRegression()
model_empl.fit(X_empl, y_empl)

# Get the coefficient and standard error for empl_immi_imputed
coefficient_empl = model_empl.coef_[0]
std_error_empl = np.std(model_empl.predict(X_empl) - y_empl, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(y_empl))

# Calculate the t-statistic and p-value for empl_immi_imputed
t_stat_empl = coefficient_empl / std_error_empl
p_value_empl = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(abs(t_stat_empl), len(y_empl) - 1))

coefficient_share, p_value_share, coefficient_empl, p_value_empl
